scripts.build: npm --workspace=apps/backend run build && npm --workspace=apps/frontend run build && npm --workspace=apps/admin run build
scripts.lint:packages: npm run lint:backend && npm run lint:frontend && npm run lint:admin
scripts.test: npm --workspace=apps/backend run test && npm --workspace=apps/frontend run test && npm --workspace=apps/admin run test
scripts.test:ci: npm --workspace=apps/backend run test:ci && npm --workspace=apps/frontend run test && npm --workspace=apps/admin run test
scripts.test:coverage: npm --workspace=apps/backend run test:coverage && npm --workspace=apps/frontend run test:coverage && npm --workspace=apps/admin run test:coverage
scripts.update: npm --workspace=apps/backend update && npm --workspace=apps/frontend update && npm --workspace=apps/admin update
scripts.qa:all: npm run qa:coverage-report && npm run qa:flaky-tests:json && npm run qa:esm-audit
